name: professional-email
description:
Writes single professional emails with clear subject lines, the ask stated in
the first three sentences, and a structured body for workplace communication.
Use when the user needs to write a work email, business correspondence, or
professional message to a colleague, manager, client, or vendor. Do NOT use
for cold outreach sequences (use `cold-email-outreach`), newsletters (use
`newsletter-writing`), or rejection letters (use `rejection-letter`).
